mode_selector_subtitle: Choose how many actors to record in this session
single_actor_desc: Stable, tested. Recommended for most scenes.
dual_actor_desc: Experimental. Requires manual setup and careful result review.
dual_actor_info: Two-actor mode uses cross-camera person association which is new and less tested. Accuracy depends on camera placement, lighting contrast between actors, and minimal occlusion. Results should be reviewed in the diagnostics screen before export.
single_actor_settings_desc: Standard recording with one person. All settings inherited from FreeMoCap defaults.
contact_expected_desc: Enables Interaction Validator. Recommends separate pickup for critical contact moments.
contact_expected_warning: When actors make physical contact, cross-camera association may produce identity swaps. Consider recording critical contact scenes separately.
association_threshold_desc: How strictly cameras must agree on person identity. Stricter = fewer false matches but may drop uncertain frames.
tracking_threshold_desc: How fast an identity can change between frames. Stricter = smoother tracks but may fail during fast motion.
shared_floor_label: Shared floor plane for both actors
shared_floor_desc: Assumes both actors stand on the same ground plane. Enable for typical indoor scenes.
aruco_fallback_label: Use ArUco markers to distinguish actors
aruco_fallback_desc: Print ArUco markers and attach to each actor's clothing. When enabled, markers override geometric identity tracking during physical contact scenes.
identity_swap_warning: Identity swap detected! Actor IDs may have switched between frames.
swap_warning_detail: This usually happens when actors cross paths or are briefly occluded. Check the diagnostics screen after recording.
problems_empty: No problems detected. Data looks clean.
problem_identity_swap: Identity swap between Actor {a1} and Actor {a2}
problem_tracking_gap: Tracking gap — actor not detected for {n} frames
btn_fix_issues: Issues found → What can I do
fix_identity_swap:
Identity swaps happen when actors cross paths or are occluded from multiple cameras. To reduce swaps:
• Increase the tracking speed threshold (stricter)
• Place cameras at different angles around the scene
• Ensure good lighting contrast between actors
fix_low_confidence:
Low confidence frames occur when cameras disagree about person identity. To improve:
• Increase the association confidence threshold (stricter)
• Reduce occlusion by adjusting camera positions
• Ensure all cameras can see both actors
fix_tracking_gap:
Tracking gaps happen when an actor is not detected by enough cameras. To fix:
• Ensure the actor is visible in at least 3 cameras
• Avoid wearing colors similar to the background
• Increase lighting in the capture area
fix_general:
General tips:
• Re-record with different thresholds using 'Reprocess'
• For critical scenes, consider recording single-actor passes
• Check camera calibration before recording
tooltip_export: Export the processed data to your chosen format
tooltip_fix_issues: View suggestions for improving data quality
tooltip_reprocess: Go back and adjust thresholds, then reprocess without re-recording
review_mode_subtitle: Drag the slider to review recorded frames with bounding boxes
review_no_data: No recorded data available yet. Complete a recording to review frames.
